location_description: The tension-clamp aluminum tube is located within the blue box in the center of the image and is inclined from the lower left to the upper right. Its left end is connected to the connecting ring through the steel anchor, while its right end is connected to the stranded conductor extending outside the blue box.
left_end_crimp: Yes | The portion near the steel anchor at the left end of the aluminum tube is cylindrical, with a smooth surface profile and no continuous hexagonal edges or regularly flattened section. The local color difference at the opening does not constitute evidence of crimping deformation.
right_end_crimp: Yes | The portion near the conductor at the right end of the aluminum tube remains cylindrical, with a smooth surface and no continuous angular crimping surface or regularly flattened section. The variation in surface brightness is not accompanied by distinct geometric deformation and therefore cannot be used to determine that crimping is present.
grade_result: Kind | Both the left and right ends are smooth cylindrical areas, with no identifiable continuous hexagonal edges, regularly flattened sections, or other crimping marks. This forms an uncrimped-uncrimped condition. According to the decision tree, the left-end inspection is Yes and the right-end inspection is also Yes, so the defect is graded as Kind.
